body.intro: By using DotToDotFreePrintables.com you agree to these terms. They are short and mostly common sense.
body.free: You may download and print any puzzle on this site, in unlimited copies, for personal, family, homeschool, and classroom use. Teachers may print for their whole class, include pages in homework packets, and share printed copies with colleagues. Libraries, therapists, and youth groups may print for the children they work with. No attribution, sign-up, or payment is required.
body.permission: You may not sell the puzzles, include them in paid products or bundles, upload the files to other websites or file-sharing services, remove the site branding, or claim them as your own. If you want to feature a puzzle somewhere — a blog, a book, an app — link to the puzzle's page on this site or ask us first. We say yes to most reasonable requests.
body.purchasePolicy: Paid puzzle packs are digital PDF products delivered immediately after successful payment. Because a digital file cannot be returned after access begins, all sales are final and we do not offer returns, exchanges, or refunds for change of mind or accidental purchases. This policy does not limit any refund, cancellation, or withdrawal right that cannot legally be excluded where you live.
body.purchaseHelp: If your download is not delivered, the file is defective, you are charged more than once, or the product is materially different from its description, email hellokidsbookworld@gmail.com with your purchase email and a description of the problem. We will provide a working replacement or an appropriate refund. By requesting immediate access at checkout, you consent to immediate delivery and acknowledge that any applicable withdrawal right may end once delivery begins.

We test every puzzle before publishing, but we make no warranties of any kind and are not liable for any damages arising from use of the site or its printables, to the maximum extent permitted by law. Adult supervision is recommended for young children using scissors or other tools alongside our activities.
